'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civl war]]
**[[War crimes during the Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|War crimes during the Sudanese civil war]]
***[[U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Antony Blinken]] accuses both sides of the conflict of committing [[war crime]]s, including [[crimes against humanity]] and [[2023 Masalit massacres|ethnic cleansing]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/12/06/politics/blinken-sudan-crimes-against-humanity/index.html (CNN)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A [[landslide]] at a [[gold mining|gold mine]] in [[Bolívar (state)|Bolívar]], [[Venezuela]], kills 12 [[miner]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/gold-mine-collapse-venezuela-kills-dozen-people-2023-12-10/ (Reuters)]
*A [[Guyana Defence Force]] helicopter goes missing while on a border [[military operation|operation]] near [[Venezuela]]. [https://newsday.co.tt/2023/12/06/guyanese-defence-force-helicopter-goes-down-near-venezuelan-border/ (Newsday)]

'''Health and environment'''
*Authorities says that [[dengue fever]] is on the rise in [[Mali]], as at least 21 deaths and 600 cases linked to the disease are reported. [https://apnews.com/article/mali-dengue-fever-955cc4b2cfa330f0bf9cc137dd968b29 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–Italy relations]]
**[[Italy]] withdraws from [[China]]'s [[Belt and Road Initiative]]. Both countries have indicated a desire to maintain [[Diplomacy|open channels of political dialogue]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/italy-withdraws-from-chinas-belt-and-road-project/article67611400.ece (AFP via ''The Hindu'')]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Foreign involvement in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***The [[United States Senate]] blocks a supplemental funding [[Bill (law)|bill]] that included financial aid for Ukraine. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2023/dec/06/republicans-ukraine-funding (''The Guardian'')]
**[[International sanctions during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 Russian crude oil price cap sanctions]]
****''[[Politico]]'' reports that efforts to [[Price-cap regulation|cap]] [[Petroleum industry in Russia|Russia's oil]] revenues has essentially failed, due to widespread circumvention, loopholes and the ongoing fuel business. [https://www.politico.eu/article/russia-oil-price-cap-ukraine-war-centre-research-energy-clean-air/ (Politico)]
****In October, [[Russia]] earned [[United States dollar|$]]11.3 billion from [[oil exports]], exceeding the amount earned prior to the start of the war. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/features/2023-12-06/oil-prices-how-russia-punched-an-11-billion-hole-in-west-s-sanctions-regime (Bloomberg)]
***[[G7]] nations agree to impose [[trade restrictions]] on [[Diamonds as an investment|non-industrial diamonds]] from Russia. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20231206-g7-leaders-agree-to-restrict-imports-of-russian-diamonds-statement (AFP via RFI)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 University of Nevada, Las Vegas shooting]]
**Three people are killed and three others injured during a [[mass shooting]] at the [[University of Nevada, Las Vegas]] in [[Las Vegas]], [[Nevada]], [[United States]]. The perpetrator is shot dead by police. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-67642512 (BBC News)]
*Former [[People's Deputy of Ukraine]] [[Illia Kyva]], who defected to Russia in March 2022, is found dead in [[Moscow Oblast]]. [https://meduza.io/en/news/2023/12/06/former-ukrainian-lawmaker-illia-kyva-found-dead-in-moscow-region (Meduza)]
*Four people are injured in a mass shooting on a [[shopping street]] in [[Brussels]], [[Belgium]]. The incident is being investigated as a gang-related crime. [https://www.politico.eu/article/mep-sweden-brussels-shooting-injured/ (Politico)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[118th United States Congress]]
**Former [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|Speaker]] [[Kevin McCarthy]] announces that he will resign from the [[United States House of Representatives]] at the end of the year. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/kevin-mccarthy-retire-end-of-december-2023-historic-ouster/ (CBS News)]
*[[Rwanda asylum plan]]
**[[Robert Jenrick]] resigns as [[Minister of State for Immigration]], citing disagreements with the [[Premiership of Rishi Sunak|UK government]]'s [[Modern immigration to the United Kingdom|asylum]] plan. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/uk-immigration-minister-robert-jenrick-quits-over-rwanda-bill-4640807 (AFP via NDTV)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Nuclear power in China]]
**[[China]] announces the world's first [[Generation IV reactor|fourth-generation nuclear reactor]] has started commercial operations at the [[Shidao Bay Nuclear Power Plant]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/china-starts-up-worlds-first-fourth-generation-nuclear-reactor-2023-12-06/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*In [[association football]], the [[Major League Soccer]] (MLS) fines [[Los Angeles FC]] $100,000 and suspended supporter group 3252 for engaging in misconduct including the lighting of illegal flares during the team match in the [[2023 MLS Cup playoffs#Conference finals|conference finals]]. [https://www.latimes.com/sports/story/2023-12-06/mls-fines-lafc-suspends-supporter-group-3252-misconduct-allegations (''Los Angeles Times'')]
